_comment: Copy to local/mvf.config.json (git-ignored) and edit. Only 'source' is required.
_bbox: EPSG:27700 [minE, minN, maxE, maxN]. Omit for the Merseyside default.
_all: true takes every tile the source holds, ignoring bbox. Use this when the source is already a selection - MAPS Viewer's tile picker installs the squares you chose to C:/MAPS, so {"source":"C:/MAPS","all":true} reproduces that selection exactly. Pointing at the disc with a bbox is more reproducible if you re-pick later.
_plant: false to skip valves/governors/syphons and extract mains only.
